short_description: Back up, compress, protect and find your files in one local Windows app. Create versioned snapshots, encrypted Sealed Files, portable GMW archives and searchable Vaults - no account required.
description:
Rat-Trap brings backup history, file compression, authenticated encryption and local search together in one Windows desktop app.

KEEP HISTORY, NOT ANOTHER PILE OF COPIES

Create verified snapshots of a folder in a local repository. Rat-Trap reuses matching content across snapshots, lets you search filenames and paths through time, pins important generations, previews retention before cleanup and restores a selected snapshot to a new folder.

PROTECT FILES YOU WANT TO KEEP OPAQUE

A Sealed File is an independently compressed .rtsf copy protected using authenticated encryption. Rat-Trap can generate an opaque exterior filename that does not expose the original basename. Open it with its password or matching .rtrk recovery key. The original plaintext file is always retained, so you stay in control of when it is removed.

CREATE PORTABLE ARCHIVES

Choose Fast, Balanced or Smallest for a portable .gmw archive. Balanced is the recommended all-round profile and stores exact duplicate files once. Optional authenticated encryption protects the complete portable archive with a password and an independently generated recovery key. Supported archives and Vaults can also be exported to standard ZIP.

TURN STORED COLLECTIONS INTO SEARCHABLE VAULTS

Queryable Vaults search filenames and supported text without first unpacking the collection. Preview or selectively export matching files. Recognised CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, NDJSON and UCI datasets can be browsed as typed local tables, filtered without SQL or queried with read-only SELECT statements.

VERIFY BEFORE YOU RESTORE

Run a quick structural check or a full check that reads stored objects and reconstructs file hashes. Backup history can be searched, pinned, restored or exported as a portable archive.

MADE FOR WINDOWS

Rat-Trap works locally and requires no account. Windows Open with support for .gmw and .rtsf selects the file in Rat-Trap but never extracts or decrypts it automatically.

IMPORTANT SECURITY AND STORAGE BOUNDARIES

Backup repositories are checksum-verified but are not currently encrypted. Encryption applies only when you choose it for portable archives or Vaults, and to Sealed Files.

Encrypted operations may use temporary plaintext working copies. Cleanup is best-effort and secure deletion is not claimed. Keep recovery keys away from the files they unlock. If both a password and its recovery key are lost, encrypted data cannot be recovered.

Sealed Files are copy-only: Rat-Trap does not delete or replace the original. Encryption is not a substitute for maintaining a separate backup.

Rat-Trap is licensed for personal and non-commercial use. Commercial use requires a separate written licence from TWO HANDS NETWORK LTD.
features: Keep versioned folder snapshots and restore any verified generation
Reuse matching data across backups and store exact duplicate files once
Compress and protect individual files as opaque Sealed Files with a separate recovery key
Create Fast, Balanced, or Smallest portable GMW archives with optional authenticated encryption
Search filenames and supported text inside Queryable Vaults without unpacking the collection
Browse CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, NDJSON, and UCI data as typed local tables
Filter structured data without SQL or run read-only SELECT queries
Run quick or full integrity checks before restore
Export supported archives and Vaults to standard ZIP
Work locally without creating a Rat-Trap account
